# Metafive.ai — Mohamed Ben Lakhoua

> Infrastructure & Cloud Architect based in Paris – La Défense (Courbevoie, France). Thirty years leading, designing and hardening critical platforms in Tunisia, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Germany and France. Independent consulting and training under the name Metafive.ai. Works in French, English and Arabic.

## What I do
- Consulting: cloud and hybrid architecture; resilience and compliance (business continuity, DORA, ISO 22301, ISO/IEC 27001 audit preparation); Service Level Management and operational excellence (the SLI → SLO → OLA → UC → SLA chain, SRE, ITIL); AI automation of IT operations with human sign-off.
- In-house training: 9 courses for IT teams in the 2026 catalogue, 1 to 3 days each.
- Courses for schools and universities: Bachelor's and Master's modules on IT service governance, infrastructure design, project steering, security and compliance.
- Technology leadership: open to CTO, VP Engineering / VP Platform and Director Infrastructure & Cloud roles.
- Lab: Metafive 360°, a personal research project on governing several AI agents, with algorithmic trading as the test bed. No investment advice, no signals, no third-party asset management.

## Training catalogue 2026
- [Agentic AI: governance, security and guardrails](https://www.metafive.ai/en/training/agentic-ai/): 2 days. Putting AI agents into production in IT without losing control of what they do.
- [The AI Act after the Digital Omnibus, and ISO/IEC 42001](https://www.metafive.ai/en/training/ai-act-iso-42001/): 1 day. Knowing what already applies, what was postponed, and building an auditable AI governance now.
- [Resilience and cyber regulation: DORA, NIS2, CRA](https://www.metafive.ai/en/training/dora-nis2-cra/): 3 days. Linking the new obligations to architecture and operations, so you hold up when a link fails and can prove it.
- [Service levels for AI: SLOs for LLMs and agents](https://www.metafive.ai/en/training/slos-for-ai/): 2 days. Applying to AI services the discipline that makes platforms reliable: measure, commit, steer.
- [Cloud and AI FinOps](https://www.metafive.ai/en/training/cloud-ai-finops/): 1 day. Making cloud, GPU and inference costs visible and arbitrable before they drift.
- [Sovereign and hybrid cloud architecture](https://www.metafive.ai/en/training/sovereign-cloud/): 3 days. Deciding where each workload belongs between public cloud, trusted cloud and private infrastructure, while keeping reversibility.
- [Platform Engineering and AI-assisted delivery](https://www.metafive.ai/en/training/platform-engineering/): 2 days. Delivering more often and more safely with an internal platform run as a product, and governed coding assistants.
- [SRE & SLOs](https://www.metafive.ai/en/training/sre-slos/): 2 days. Measuring reliability from the user's point of view, setting objectives and steering trade-offs with the error budget.
- [Service Level Management: SLAs, OLAs and UCs](https://www.metafive.ai/en/training/service-level-management/): 2 days. Writing achievable service commitments, from the customer contract down to internal teams and suppliers.

Format: 6 to 12 participants from the same organisation, working on your real cases. On site in the Paris region, or remote in half-day sessions. In French, English or Arabic; materials in French or English. Programme adjusted after a scoping interview; courses can be combined into tracks. The courses do not prepare for official certification exams and are not legal advice. Prices are not published.

## Track record
- 2022 – 2026: Global Director, Platform Engineering & Cloud Operations, The Sandbox · Paris. Global consumer platform, 8M+ users; reporting to the CTO, with Executive Committee exposure.
- 2018 – 2022: Head of Platform Operations & Cloud Delivery, ]init[ AG · Berlin. Public sector and regulated financial services: NATO, European Patent Office, Stuttgart Stock Exchange.
- 2008 – 2018: Director, Regional Operations & Platform Delivery, ]init[ AG · Abu Dhabi. e-Government programme: a sovereign Tier-4 platform connecting 50+ ministries, agencies and banks, run 24/7.
- 1997 – 2008: Chief Information Officer, Qatar Foundation · Doha. National digital services under formal service commitments.

## Where and how
Based in Paris – La Défense. On-site, hybrid or remote engagements.
